entities.notes: known-limitation: identifier split mid-number at a page boundary. In the committed extraction (pdfplumber 0.11.9, pages joined with a blank line), 'UDA643' and '321' are separated by two newlines from the page break, leaving a gap a naive checksum/regex recognizer may fail to bridge -- this is exactly the cross-page recovery-window join behavior the fixture exists to exercise.
